items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Buildings-only policy: theft is not an insured peril (2.1, 3.1.4), and personal articles plus property in a conveyance away from the insured location are not insured (4.3(d)-(f)). Not indemnified.
Conveyance and journey costs are expressly not insured costs (5.2.5, 7.1.8(d)), and there is no insured event at all. Not indemnified.
